notes.title: Quick Fixes #4
notes.content:
We've just released a small update addressing some issues reported during the tutorial. Thank you for your feedback!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Luke or Sebastian could be arrested during certain tutorial moments, potentially blocking progression.
[*]     Fixed a bug where firing a taser near an opponent could scare them, which should not happen in the tutorial.
[*]     Fixed a rare case where Sebastian could interrupt the shield-grab animation, pushing the player away and leaving input inactive.
[*]     Reduced excessive body-pushing during missions, which could disrupt player interactions.
[/list]

We're working hard to improve the experience!

notes.title: Quick Fixes #3
notes.content:
A small update just went live with the following fixes:

1. Shield Re-Equip Issue Fixed – The player character now correctly re-equips the shield after taking a hit. This was especially confusing during the tutorial fight where you’re supposed to lose and regain your shield.
2. Tutorial Progression Tweaks – Minor adjustments have been made to prevent rare cases where players could get stuck during the tutorial flow.
3. Frank Blocking Doorways – Fixed a rare issue where Frank could block the doorway and refuse to move, halting progress.

notes.title: Quick Fixes #2
notes.content:
We’ve just pushed a small patch to address several early issues reported by the community. Thank you for your feedback!

 Fixes included in this update:

[list]

[*]     Missing Chinese translations in some menu elements have been added.
[*]     Pressing PgUp / PgDn could cause the camera to detach from the player – this has been fixed.
[*]     At the outpost, players were able to enter restricted area before picking up the access card, which could lead to bugs – now correctly blocked.
[*]     Players could get pushed through the wall in the corner of the training room – collision has been corrected.
[/list]
